question.text: Clearing Corporations announce the settlement schedule for various segments/products on what basis?

explanation.text: The Logic: Clearing Corporations announce settlement schedules for various segments and products on a periodic basis so that members and investors have an up-to-date timeline for pay-in and pay-out. The Trap: The schedule is not daily and not fixed annually, and it is not communicated only when changes happen — it is published on a periodic basis as a matter of course. Note: Stem subject-verb agreement corrected to "Clearing Corporations announce".
